annotations.text: Editorial — the locked-in direction. Warm paper canvas, mockup-driven hero, closest to the console's own visual language.

Editorial Nights — a dark-mode exploration, not a 1:1 color invert. Ember is demoted from "everywhere" accent to a rare "this is live, right now" signal (the live dot, Cup Taster's badge, the completed-event tag). A new warm gold — "lantern" — takes over everyday buttons/links/icons, evoking lamplight rather than the trophy-brass already reserved for Annual/BTC (kept, now as an outline). Canvas is a warm espresso brown-black, not neutral. Both photos get a night color-grade rather than new shoots.
